At Ethereum block 26197390 (2026-10-15T10:43:11Z) about 30.4% of accounted USDT lender claims sit in the WBTC-collateralized market, whose BTC backing the WBTC issuer discloses as held by licensed custodians; wstETH and sUSDS markets carry onchain and Sky-protocol collateral, and cbBTC exposure is negligible. This evidences heterogeneous custody layers and supports the mixed whole-book label, not a direct holder claim against any custodian. Complete ultimate custody, enforceable segregation, successor custody and legal insolvency protection are not established by the receipt code or parent reserve disclosures. No custody share percentage is inferred from collateral value.
